text: Anesthesiology is a medical discipline that studies how to achieve safe analgesia, muscle relaxation, consciousness control and life function support during surgery or diagnosis and treatment, and it has the attributes of both basic medicine and clinical medicine. The training objective is: Through systematic study of the basic theories, clinical skills and perioperative management knowledge of anesthesia, students will be equipped with the ability to design anesthesia plans, handle critical conditions, diagnose and treat pain, and conduct scientific research and innovation. They will be able to engage in clinical anesthesia, emergency resuscitation and pain treatment in positions such as anesthesiology departments, pain departments and intensive care units (icus) in hospitals at all levels.
